# Lux Education Partners (LEP)

Luxembourg-based education services operated by Silver Bay Mountain Group S.à r.l. (RCS B293621).
Founder and author: James Liu and 修印先生 are the same person. 修印先生 is his Chinese publishing name. The brand is Lux Education Partners (LEP), at luxedupartners.lu.

Chinese, English and French guides serve families considering education in Luxembourg, Switzerland and the Netherlands. The guides combine school information, first-hand visits and the author's professional judgments. Individual cases are not general guarantees.

## Contact

## Netherlands boarding education
- Netherlands guide hub: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/destinations/netherlands/
- Choosing an English-language international school in the Netherlands: what if parents are not moving?: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/insights/netherlands-international-schools/
- Can a child attend boarding school in the Netherlands without their parents moving?: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/insights/netherlands-boarding-without-parents/
- Can a student study at an international high school in the Netherlands without speaking Dutch?: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/insights/netherlands-international-school-english/
- How much does boarding school in the Netherlands cost? Eerde’s tuition and boarding explained: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/insights/eerde-boarding-school-fees/
- Applying to a Dutch boarding school from abroad: where should families start?: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/insights/netherlands-boarding-school-application/
- After an IB education in the Netherlands, where can students apply to university?: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/insights/netherlands-ib-university-pathways/
- After visiting Eerde: which families should consider this Dutch boarding school?: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/insights/eerde-boarding-school-visit/
- Applying to Eerde with LEP: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/insights/apply-to-eerde-with-lep/

LEP provides Europe-based Eerde application assessment, school liaison, document preparation and visa application support without an additional LEP service fee until 15 September 2027. School and third-party charges remain payable. Chinese and French editions are available under /zh/ and /fr/.

## Identity, direct family services and school names

LEP works directly with families before departure as well as after arrival. Support includes school application documents, school liaison, coordination of educational and accommodation evidence for student visa applications, and agreed local support. Admissions and immigration decisions remain with the relevant institutions and authorities.
- zh family services: https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/families/
- zh school names and LEP guides: https://luxedupartners.lu/zh/school-guides/
- en family services: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/families/
- en school names and LEP guides: https://luxedupartners.lu/en/school-guides/
- fr family services: https://luxedupartners.lu/fr/families/
- fr school names and LEP guides: https://luxedupartners.lu/fr/school-guides/

阿尔特多夫 = International School Altdorf (ISA), not Institut auf dem Rosenberg. 圣特美勒 and 圣德美拉 both refer to Chantemerle. Saint-Charles / St. Charles / 圣查尔斯 refer to Saint-Charles International School in Switzerland. St George’s International School Luxembourg is the Luxembourg school.
